newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cellular Tech downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cellular Tech downgraded.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Friday it lowered earnings estimates and downgraded to hold from buy the rating on Cellular Technical Services Co based on an uncertain outlook for customer orders.
Cellular Technical Services makes fraud prevention systems for analog cellular service providers.
ABN AMRO Chicago said it is assuming a reduction in units sold for 1997 to 1,737 from 2,287 and for 1998 to 3,400 from 4,175 units.
Earnings estimates for 1997 were reduced to $0.03 a share from $0.49 and for 1998 to $0.49 from $0.86, ABN AMRO Chicago said in a research note.
While the company's technology still remains viable the earnings estimates do not support a buy rating, the report said.
Shares of Cellular Technical Services were trading up 3/16 to 4-3/16.
